No.: MUN/LND/PMTAQ/05/04/06' BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the Order under Section 38 (a) of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule. Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,09th April, 2025.

2. Description of the Land.– Allotment of land depicted in the Preliminary Plan mQ 5499 dated 25.11.2020 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Mundalama Village in No.610, Mundalama Grama Niladhari Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mundalama in Puttalam District of North Western Province and bounded as.

01. Lot No.1 – Mundal Mathurasa – Extent:1.1746 Hectares North: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Lot No.6307 of Preliminary Plan mQ 1265; South: Lot No.3 of Preliminary Plan mQ 926; West: Road (Road Development Authority).
